environment: Windows interactive account, isolated loopback Jellyfin 10.11.11 and 12.0.0, owned generated media

checks.name: metadata observation and queued approval survive actual host restart
all metadata waits for a later host scan
selected protected child prevents metadata disposal
all metadata restoration recovers exact original bytes
selected metadata restoration recovers exact original bytes
custom-all metadata restoration recovers exact original bytes
custom-selected metadata restoration recovers exact original bytes
same-size metadata edit with retained timestamp refuses disposal
actual metadata recycle failure preserves bytes and approval
server configuration restored after custom metadata acceptance

limitations: Controlled default and custom roots. Regression suite covers returning owners, path escapes and protected content.
